# EMS Technologies

> EMS Technologies is the exclusive India distributor for Lackwerke Peters GmbH & Co. KG (Germany), supplying ELPEGUARD conformal coatings, ESD packing solutions and selective conformal coating machines, and providing on-site conformal coating job work. Its office and factory are in Maheswaram, Ranga Reddy District, Hyderabad, Telangana 501510, India, operating since 2011.

## Facts

- Company: EMS Technologies
- Founded: 2011
- Office & factory: Maheswaram, Ranga Reddy District, Hyderabad, Telangana 501510, India
- Geo coordinates: 17.1815452, 78.506483
- Google Plus Code: 7J9W5GJ4+JH9
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/iiCpggDXyqzfSdMC7
- Manufacturing plants: Hyderabad (Telangana) and Cochin (Kerala), since 2015
- Role: Exclusive India distributor for Lackwerke Peters GmbH & Co. KG, Germany
- Phone: +91-9394116660
- Email: info@emstechnologies.in

## Products & Services

- Conformal coatings (Peters ELPEGUARD): acrylic, polyurethane, silicone, thick-film curing, aqua (water-based): https://emstechnologies.in/conformal/
- Conformal coating job work (on-site): application, UV optical inspection, curing, thickness testing, removal, rework, final inspection: https://emstechnologies.in/services/conformal-coating-job-work/
- ESD paint job work (on-site): ProtectA Pro ESD conductive and anti-static paints for floors, walls, surfaces and bins, with earthing and resistance testing: https://emstechnologies.in/services/esd-paint-job-work/
- ESD bags: anti-static bubble, static shielding, LDPE pink, conductive grid: https://emstechnologies.in/EsdBags/
- PP corrugated ESD trays & bins: https://emstechnologies.in/products/pp-bins/
- EPE foam trays: https://emstechnologies.in/products/conductive-foam-trays/
- ESD thermoforming trays: https://emstechnologies.in/products/thermoforming-trays/
- Selective coating machines (ALTD-450B, ALTD-450J): https://emstechnologies.in/SCMachines/
